econ-hot-01-c2.text: David Hume (1752). Of the Balance of Trade (Essays, Moral, Political, and Literary). Liberty Fund / Library of Economics and Liberty.
econ-hot-01-c2.quote: Suppose four-fifths of all the money in GREAT BRITAIN to be annihilated in one night.
econ-hot-01-c2.claim: David Hume's specie-flow mechanism (1752) showed the sequence.

econ-hot-01-c3.text: History of Economic Thought website, The New School. Physiocracy: Introduction. HET Website (hetwebsite.net).
econ-hot-01-c3.quote: The Physiocrats' fundamental axiom is that only agriculture is "productive" (i.e. yields a net product).
econ-hot-01-c3.claim: Their core claim was that only land produces a 'net product', meaning output exceeding the labor and inputs used.
